look_here_first: Look for the low spreading habit, huge yellow evening-opening flowers, and especially the very large winged fruits. It is a dry limestone-prairie plant, not a tall riverbank primrose.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: low perennial, often spreading to ascending

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dry calcareous prairie, limestone glades, and rocky hillsides

lookalikes.differences: The oversized winged capsule is the strongest field clue. O. jamesii is taller and riparian; O. patriciae has much smaller white-to-rose gaura-like flowers and narrow fruits.
